super-hexagon.title: Super Hexagon - Challenge Your Reflexes with Rhythmic Action
super-hexagon.slogan: Feel the Beat, Escape the Hexas
super-hexagon.description: Super Hexagon offers a unique musical experience that challenges your improvisation skills. Navigate through a world of revolving hexagons, avoid incoming walls, and immerse yourself in powerful electronic music. The game's pace increases continuously, testing your reflexes and concentration. Play now and see how long you can survive in this thrilling rhythm-based adventure!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Super Hexagon is a rhythm-based game that tests your reflexes and concentration. Navigate through a world of revolving hexagons and avoid incoming walls to survive.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Use the left and right arrow keys to rotate the hexagon.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Avoid walls that appear from the edges of the hexagons.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Keep up with the increasing pace and survive as long as possible.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Sync your moves with the beat of the music for an immersive experience.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: The game's pace increases continuously, testing your reflexes and concentration.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Powerful and attractive electronic music enhances the gameplay experience.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Challenge yourself to unlock achievements and improve your skills.
